title: Choosing the Right Strategy
content:
The Stress of a Lingering Listing: Why Proper Pricing Matters

Endless ShowingsConstant disruptions and preparations can be exhausting.
Price Drops Create UncertaintyAdjusting the price multiple times can make buyers wonder how low the seller will go.
Market Perception ChangesThe longer a home sits, the less desirable it appears to buyers.
Financial StrainCarrying the mortgage, taxes, and maintenance costs for a longer-than-expected period can add up.

Pros and Cons of Each Strategy

StrategyProsCons
Starting High and Adjusting DownCan maximize profit if the right buyer is foundRisk of home sitting too long, leading to price cuts
Starting Just Below Market to Drive DemandCan generate multiple offers and create bidding warsRisk of underselling if bidding does not occur
Pricing to SellMoves the home quickly and reduces stressMay leave money on the table if market conditions shift
Pricing to NegotiateProvides room for buyer offers and negotiationsCan deter buyers if perceived as overpriced

Experience in All Pricing Strategies

I have successfully used all pricing strategies, and I understand that there is no one-size-fits-all approach. Each method has its advantages and drawbacks, and the best choice depends on the market conditions, the seller’s goals, and the property itself.

Bottom line: the right price = faster sale & higher profits. Every home and market is unique, and there is no single right way to price. My experience across all pricing strategies ensures that we choose the best approach tailored to your situation, maximizing your return while minimizing your time on the market.
